name: Belmond Jimbaran Puri
insider_take: This intimate beachfront sanctuary captures the essence of a traditional Balinese village, where ancient royal palms whisper stories of old kingdoms and sacred ceremonies unfold at nearby clifftop temples.
whats_special: Belmond Jimbaran Puri sits on one of Bali's most coveted stretches of golden sand, where local fishermen still launch their colorful jukung boats at dawn. The resort's design mirrors a authentic Balinese village, complete with traditional thatched-roof cottages and lush tropical gardens that house over 100 species of native plants.
pro_tip: Book a beachfront cottage during full moon - Jimbaran's calm bay creates perfect reflections, and you'll witness the magical nightly departure of fishing boats illuminated by lanterns.
dont_miss: The legendary Jimbaran seafood dining experience right on the beach, where local warungs grill the day's catch as the sun sets. Plus, you're just 10 minutes from the sacred Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on 250-foot cliffs with its famous Kecak fire dance performances.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Jimbaran Bay with stunning sunset views
Traditional Balinese cottage-style accommodations with authentic architecture
Exceptional spa services and wellness programs in tropical garden setting
Award-winning beachfront dining with fresh seafood and Indonesian cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive Belmond brand positioning
Traditional cottage design may have limited modern amenities compared to contemporary resorts
